summary: Great topic, punishing classic game: the obvious guesses are famous modern bestsellers that sit at #11 to #108 and each cost a life. Belongs in Blitz once the rebuild gives it stats.
reasons: Casual player found 3 (Harry Potter 1, Da Vinci Code, The Hobbit) and lost all 5 lives on Hunger Games, Fifty Shades, Mockingbird, Gatsby and Catcher in the Rye before getting to The Alchemist.
The top 10 leans on old and translated classics (Tale of Two Cities, Dream of the Red Chamber, She) while the 160-deep pool holds every famous modern novel, so the natural guesses are costly misses.
The Bible, Quran, Lord of the Rings, Twilight and Don Quixote are free but say 'not an answer for this list' with no reason given; players will think the list is broken.
Fan found 9 but still ran out of lives; She: A History of Adventure is a stretch almost nobody under 35 knows.
Matcher is solid: sorcerer's stone, harry potter 1, philosophers stone, alice in wonderland, little prince, davinci code, tale of two cities all match.
Strong Blitz candidate after the rebuild: an informal 90 s run scored 26 of 30 named titles.
fixes: Prompt should say religious and political texts and multi-volume works are excluded, e.g. 'Name the 10 best-selling single books of all time (no religious or political texts)', so Bible, Quran, Little Red Book and Lord of the Rings don't feel like wrong rejections.

Drop universeCategories 'Novels adapted into films': the category page only adds obscure titles (Doom 94, Heart Lock, Junkers Come Here, Lalsalu, Nondito Noroke, The Garden of Evening Mists, Women Without Men) that cost a life and add nothing.
Clean the garbled extra name '六星占術によるあなたの運命 Tells Your Fortune)' (stray parenthesis, half-translated).

Prune junk redirect aliases on the top 10: character and plot names (Vengeance, Roger Cly, Mrs. Cruncher, Théophile Gabelle, Emily Brent, Vera Claythorne, Sophie Neveu, Bezu Fache, Leigh Teabing, Cryptex, Arkenstone, Asteroid B, B 612), 'The Da Vinci Code paintings', 'Lord of the Rings Prequel' and the inverted 'Tale of Two Cities, A'.
After the rebuild attaches sales figures, re-judge for daily-blitz.
